name: ⚔️ Colosseum Catcher
description:
Catch wild beasts, train them and fight your way up the COLOSSEUM!

⚔️ Turn-based battles with 7 elements
🔮 Catch 24 original beasts - find a rare PRISMATIC one!
🏛️ Beat 8 champions to earn their crests
🔥 Endless Gauntlet: how far can you go?
🤝 Duel your friends for trophies
✨ Beasts ascend into stronger forms

New beasts every update!
